text: ‘Only rich people benefit from global migration.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Transnational organisations have been successful in improving life chances in developing
countries.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Postmodernists are right that social reality today is shaped by the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Governments control the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion functions to bind people together in society.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘There is clear evidence that religion has lost its social significance.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
